items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep external permission outreach unsent, and authorize no public exposure, alert expansion, monetization, deployment, tracking change, or requeue. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, security, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle plus field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment without enabling new tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and data-request inventory.

Site compliance disposition: complicated.work is conditional-to-blocked for exposure because it is reachable but fails banner, accept, reject, and GA4 checks; remediate and capture a passing checklist before launch or monetization. deadlymaracas.com remains blocked for launch because DNS failure makes compliance status unknown; retain parked status until reachability and checklist evidence exist. Other private, parked, or evidence-only sites require one concrete owner disposition before launch-state changes. Ordinary reversible growth may continue where existing legal boundaries are preserved.

Retain containment-only execution. Do not create new production, telemetry, spend, deployment, requeue, experiment, or monetization proposals this cycle. Continue only existing legal, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, failure-repair, and owner-disposition work using recorded evidence. Preserve aggregate affiliate earnings as unattributed and do not infer revenue, ROI, margin, payback, causal lift, or readiness.
